context: The teal horizontal line and gold vertical marks in sandbox images are the actual world range ruler drawn by ONEGameMode.cpp:189-197, not a HUD panel border/clipping artifact.
The raw checks and folder use the legacy Candidate05 fixture label. These twelve images are newly generated by the exact Candidate07 packaged runtime above; historical pixels were not reused.

Each size has 49 passing automated assertions. Fixture input is Controller InputKey and SetMouseLocation with an explicit 1500 spend fixture, safe-contact box teleport and fatal damage packet. Pixel review does not turn those into native controls or ordinary death gameplay.
Engine frame numbers are retained. World seconds reset after actual level restart; six screenshots are sparse states, not a continuous timeline.
limits: Only these twelve UI stills at two resolutions were inspected. No other resolution, full motion, infected anatomy/physicality or perceptual audio approval.

Active power-up timers, intermediate health regeneration/vignette states and PaP warnings are outside these six states; tray controls/help are visible but this review does not claim every button was clicked.

Original PNG, result, engine log, checks and input-trace hashes were rechecked. Six runtime identities were compared with the actual build receipt and verified runner reports, not rehashed during another running game.
No engine launch, source edit, screenshot replacement, image encoding, desktop capture, user-input action, audit completion or release-publication claim.
